```{r}
library(tidyverse)

triggerR <- new.env()
walk(list.files("R", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.R$"), ~ source(.x, local = triggerR))

gps_utci_hourly <- triggerR$read_gps_utci_hourly(resolution = "hourly", neighbours = 1) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(hour_ts, tz = "UTC"),
         month = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(hour_ts, "month")))

stress_levels <- c("Extreme cold", "Very strong cold", "Strong cold", "Moderate cold", "Slight cold",
                   "No thermal stress", "Moderate heat", "Strong heat", "Very strong heat", "Extreme heat")
stress_colors <- c(
  "Extreme cold" = "#1E3A8A", "Very strong cold" = "#2563EB",
  "Strong cold" = "#60A5FA", "Moderate cold" = "#93C5FD",
  "Slight cold" = "#DBEAFE", "No thermal stress" = "#D1D5DB",
  "Moderate heat" = "#FDBA74", "Strong heat" = "#FB923C",
  "Very strong heat" = "#EA580C", "Extreme heat" = "#B91C1C")

gps_utci_hourly <- gps_utci_hourly |>
  mutate(stress = cut(utci, breaks = c(-Inf, -40, -27, -13, 0, 9, 26, 32, 38, 46, Inf),
                      labels = stress_levels, right = FALSE))
```

## GPS–UTCI coverage

Counts below refer to **participant-hours with a GPS observation**, not all hours in the study period. A GPS hour is assigned only when its grid cells satisfy the spatial rule; UTCI coverage additionally requires a non-missing UTCI value for the assigned grid point and hour.

```{r}
coverage <- gps_utci_hourly |>
  summarise(
    participants = n_distinct(userId),
    gps_hours = n(),
    gps_assigned_hours = sum(gps_assigned, na.rm = TRUE),
    gps_utci_hours = sum(gps_utci_available, na.rm = TRUE),
    gps_assigned_pct = 100 * gps_assigned_hours / gps_hours,
    gps_utci_pct = 100 * gps_utci_hours / gps_hours,
    gps_utci_assigned_pct = 100 * gps_utci_hours / gps_assigned_hours)

print(coverage, width = Inf)
```

## Observed thermal stress

These results describe **hours with both valid GPS grid assignment and UTCI**. They do not represent continuous individual exposure between GPS observations.

```{r}
#| label: fig-stress
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6

gps_utci_hourly |>
  filter(gps_utci_available, !is.na(stress)) |>
  count(stress, .drop = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(stress, n, fill = stress)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stress_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Observed participant-hours",
       title = "Thermal stress at observed GPS locations") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

## Hot days observed by GPS

A **hot observed day** is a participant-day with at least one matched GPS hour reaching 32 °C UTCI (strong heat stress). A day is not classified as cool merely because no hot hour was observed: GPS sampling may be sparse.

```{r}
gps_utci_daily <- triggerR$read_gps_utci("daily")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hot-days
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

gps_utci_daily |>
  filter(gps_utci_available) |>
  mutate(hot_day = utci_max >= 32) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, utci_max)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = hot_day), alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(32, 38, 46), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#2C7FB8", "TRUE" = "#D95F0E"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Daily maximum UTCI (°C)",
       title = "Maximum daily UTCI by participant",
       subtitle = "Dashed thresholds: 32, 38 and 46 °C; each point is a participant-day") +
  theme_bw()
```

## Sleep - UTCI & GPS Coverage

```{r}
#| label: utci-sleep-coverage

sleep <- triggerR$.read_trigger_csv("sleep_tidy") |>
  select(userId, date, sleepduration)

utci_sleep <- gps_utci_daily |>
  filter(gps_utci_available) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date) + 1) |>
  inner_join(sleep, by = c("userId", "date")) 
```

```{r}
utci_sleep |>
  summarise(
    participants = n_distinct(userId),
    days = n_distinct(userId, date),
    first_date = min(date),
    last_date = max(date))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-gps-sleep-calendar
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

#| label: fig-gps-sleep-calendar
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

metadata <- triggerR$read_participant_metadata() |>
  select(userId, nationality)

gps_days <- gps_utci |> distinct(userId, date) |> mutate(gps = TRUE)
sleep_days <- sleep |> distinct(userId, date) |> mutate(sleep = TRUE)

calendar <- full_join(gps_days, sleep_days, by = c("userId", "date")) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "userId") |>
  mutate(
    gps = replace_na(gps, FALSE),
    sleep = replace_na(sleep, FALSE),
    coverage = case_when(gps & sleep ~ "GPS + Sleep", gps ~ "GPS only", sleep ~ "Sleep only")
  )

order <- calendar |> distinct(userId, nationality) |> arrange(nationality, userId) |> pull(userId)
calendar <- calendar |> mutate(userId = factor(userId, levels = rev(order)))
nationality_tiles <- calendar |> distinct(userId, nationality) |> mutate(date = max(calendar$date) + 10)

ggplot(calendar, aes(date, userId)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = coverage), width = 0.9, height = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("GPS + Sleep" = "#238B45", "GPS only" = "#3182BD", "Sleep only" = "#FDAE6B")) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_tile(data = nationality_tiles, aes(fill = nationality), width = 5, height = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", na.value = "grey80", name = "Nationality") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y", expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Participant", title = "GPS and sleep availability by participant and day") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-utci-sleep-stress
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

utci_sleep |>
  mutate(stress = cut(utci_max,
    breaks = c(-Inf, -40, -27, -13, 0, 9, 26, 32, 38, 46, Inf),
    labels = stress_levels, right = FALSE)) |>
  distinct(userId, date, stress) |>
  count(stress, .drop = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(stress, n, fill = stress)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stress_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Participant-days with GPS, UTCI and sleep",
       title = "Thermal stress distribution on days with sleep data") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

```{r}
quantile(utci_sleep$sleepduration, seq(0,1,.1))
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
utci_sleep |>
  #filter(between(sleepduration, 0, 720)) |>
  mutate(bin = cut_width(sleepduration, width = 60, boundary = 0, closed = "left")) |>
  group_by(bin) |>
  summarise(n = n(), utci_max = mean(utci_max, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(bin, n, fill = utci_max)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#313695", "#4575B4", "#74ADD1", "#ABD9E9",
                "#E0F3F8", "#FFFFBF", "#FEE090", "#FDAE61",
                "#F46D43", "#D73027", "#A50026"),
    name = "Mean daily max UTCI (°C)") +
  labs(x = "Sleep duration (60-minute bins)", y = "Observations") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
utci_sleep |>
  ggplot(aes(x = utci_max, y = sleepduration)) +
  geom_point()
```


```{r}
utci_sleep |>
  #filter(sleepduration <= 720) |>
  summarise(pearson = cor(sleepduration, utci_max),
            spearman = cor(sleepduration, utci_max, method = "spearman"))
```
